suggested_requirements.text: PeaZip shall create compressed archives in supported formats including 7z, ARC, BZ2, GZ, PAQ, PEA, QUAD, TAR, UPX, and ZIP.
PeaZip shall update existing compressed archives by adding new objects.
PeaZip shall extract the content of compressed archives to a user-specified folder.
PeaZip shall perform secure file deletion by executing multiple successive passes over the storage area.
PeaZip shall perform byte to byte comparison between two files.
PeaZip shall calculate checksums and hashes over selected files.
PeaZip shall append a timestamp with date and time to the managed archive name.
PeaZip shall support two-factor authentication using a password and a keyfile for managed archives.
PeaZip shall allow users to execute functions as command prompt commands.
PeaZip shall extract and save resulting command prompt commands into a text file.
PeaZip shall check files to find duplicates and corruption.
PeaZip shall split files into multiple volumes and merge split volumes back to the original file.
PeaZip shall display the content of a file or archive represented as hexadecimal values.
PeaZip shall provide access to system disk utilities including clean, defrag, and manage.
PeaZip shall provide access to system management tools including control panel, computer management, and task manager.
PeaZip shall display system environment variables for Linux and Windows.
PeaZip shall rate the host system in terms of MIPS and Core 2 Duo equivalent speed.
PeaZip shall support drag and drop of objects from the computer system to the application interfaces.
PeaZip shall support dragging an archived object from the application to the computer system for extraction on Microsoft Windows.
PeaZip shall generate random passwords and random keyfiles.
PeaLauncher shall provide a graphical display of the progress and status of currently executed functions.
PeaZip shall allow users to modify the application language through a localization menu.
PeaZip shall allow users to customize the graphical interface including colors, icons, fonts, and window opacity.
PeaZip shall be compatible with all 32-bit and 64-bit versions of Microsoft Windows.
PeaZip shall be compatible with POSIX operating systems including Linux and BSD.
PeaZip shall require an x-86 compatible CPU for performance critical sections written in ASM.
PeaZip shall be available as a standalone portable application that does not require installation.
The application shall function correctly even in cases of wrong data insertion or incorrect settings.
The application shall provide users with appropriate help messages in case of an error.
PeaZip shall prevent the extraction of encrypted archives without the insertion of the correct password and keyfile.
PeaZip shall ensure no data remains in the storage area after a secure deletion procedure is completed.
The application shall be usable by individuals without specific computer experience through the use of manuals and provided warnings.
